overview: The committee met to receive a presentation from the Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford regarding city support for arts and culture. The council discussed funding gaps for local grants, the necessity of a municipal arts liaison to coordinate cross-departmental logistics, and upcoming community events like Medford Open Studios.

items.title: Resolution 26107: Presentation on Arts and Culture Support
items.summary: The Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford provided an overview of local arts programming, funding trends, and the need for professional staff to manage city-wide coordination. Representatives requested increased municipal budget allocations and the creation of a staff liaison position to navigate permitting and secure external grants.

items.title: Council Discussion and Public Comment
items.summary: Councilors discussed the integration of arts into the vacant building ordinance and the limitations of the Council's budget authority, while public commenters advocated for a makerspace and professional staffing. One resident expressed opposition to increased funding for Arts Collaborative Medford, citing concerns over specific past programming.

items.title: Adjournment
items.summary: The motion to approve the item and adjourn passed.
